defs.def: without doubt 无疑；确定；肯定

ex.s: But it can certainly keep me entertained while I wait for my wife to rescue me.
ex.t: 但它肯定能在我等妻子来解救我的时候让我保持愉悦。

ex.s: From a 21st-century point of view, the printed book is certainly ancient, but it remains as interactive as any battery-powered e-reader.
ex.t: 从21世纪的角度看，印刷书固然古老，但它仍像任何电池供电的电子阅读器一样具有互动性。

ex.s: I’m certainly not going to advise my friend or anyone else to invest in quantum computers.
ex.t: 我当然不会建议我的朋友或任何人投资量子计算机。

ex.s: Language is certainly a barrier for many people.
ex.t: 语言对许多人来说无疑是个障碍。

ex.s: "Pruitt is certainly providing a 34    , but it's not just the bikes.
ex.t: “普鲁伊特无疑提供了一种34___，但意义不止于自行车。”

ex.s: With the current footprint of humanity, “it seems that global collapse is certain to happen in some form, possibly within a decade, certainly within this century,” Johnson said in an email.
ex.t: 约翰逊在电子邮件中说，以人类目前的足迹来看，“全球崩溃似乎注定会以某种形式发生，可能在本十年内，肯定在本世纪内”。

ex.s: I must say that I have certainly come to enjoy camping.
ex.t: 我必须说我确实已经开始喜欢露营了。

ex.s: But scientists all agree that if Franklin had actually touched the key, he would certainly have died from the electric shock.
ex.t: 但科学家们都同意，如果富兰克林真的摸到了钥匙，他肯定会死于电击。

ex.s: Exhibits such as these are certainly new and exciting, but are they really art?
ex.t: 像这样的展览肯定是新的和令人兴奋的，但它们真的是艺术品吗？

defs.def: of course 用于回答问题

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.
ex.t: 同样，企业界当然也经历了相当多的颠覆，但直到最近几十年，"颠覆者"才成为我们谈论大企业时一个可识别的角色。

ex.s: In fact, more than one account suggests that while Newton was certainly inspired by a falling apple, there is no proof that it hit him on the head.
ex.t: 事实上，不止一个说法表明，虽然牛顿确实受到一个落下的苹果的启发，但没有证据证明它砸中了他的头。

ex.s: Tell them that although I won’t be there in body, I’ll certainly be there in spirit!
ex.t: 告诉他们，虽然我不会在那里，但我一定会在精神上在那里！
